title: Robert I NDE 3539
content: I was standing on a pier four inches above a body of water. I looked down into the water and saw a beautiful bluish white light. The light started out about the size of a baseball. I felt a presence to my right. I turned to see who or what it was, and there stood a man clad only in a loincloth, clean-shaven, with shoulder length brown wavy hair. Without saying a word, he dove from the pier, and headed toward the light in the water. A soft voice urged me to follow him. My thoughts were, 'I can't follow, I would surely drown.' The voice said, 'Trust me, you will not drown, you will be able to breathe. Trust me.' So, I jumped in behind this man. Toward the ever-growing light I went. I found myself struggling for air, afraid to inhale, the voice said again, 'Trust Me.' Lo and behold, I slowly started to inhale, and I was amazed that I could actually breathe water! As the ball of comforting light got closer, I felt a peace inside that I have never felt before or since. The image of a city started to appear as I got closer. The houses and lots were terraced, and translucently outlined in a beautiful warm blue light. There were children running and playing in the yards. As my feet landed firmly on the ground, people started coming out or the dwellings toward me. The closer the people came, I recognized my father first, and who had passed away in 1969! Then my grandfather, grandmother, aunts, and uncles that had passed on. We formed a huddle arms over shoulders, and the feeling of complete weightlessness - no gravity - I felt my soul melding with the huddle. Without mouths moving, I relate it to mental telepathy; a voice asked me if there was anything that I needed. I was at TOTAL peace so there was nothing I needed. I asked if I could stay and a voice boomed, 'Your mission is not complete. You cannot stay. Please do not rush back.' At that moment, the huddle started to let go, and I started to lift off the ground. I floated up and the people started to return to their dwellings. I got farther and farther away from the warm beautiful light. I looked up and saw the surface of the water and there was the edge of the pier. I grabbed the edge and pulled myself up to where my belly was on the edge of the pier, and suddenly woke up in the recovery room of the hospital. There sat the anesthesiologist. She asked me how I was, and I said 'You won't believe where I just went!!' She said, 'Oh I probably will.' I told her about my experience, and she divulged that she had accidently put me too deep. She also told me that she has heard similar accounts, and got up and left! I felt sad that I could not stay, but after thinking about the words, 'Your mission is not complete' rang through my thoughts. You see, I had not had my two great children yet. I really wonder exactly just WHAT my mission is!

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Movement through water toward an ever-growing light.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man "clad only in a loincloth" who dove in first; also an unseen guiding voice.

environment.environment_other_detail: A city with terraced houses/lots outlined in warm blue light; children running/playing in yards.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: "Your mission is not complete. You cannot stay." (Experiencer later connects this with not yet having had "my two great children yet.")

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transition involved entering water and being told he could breathe it; a "city" appeared; formed a weightless huddle with deceased relatives.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Began already at a liminal scene on a pier, then moved through water toward a light; arrival in a city preceded/merged with encounters with deceased relatives; return involved floating back up to the water surface and waking in hospital recovery.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The transition was described as jumping into water and learning to "breathe water" while moving toward a growing bluish-white light; arrival included a terraced city outlined in warm blue light with children playing.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Trust me, you will not drown, you will be able to breathe. Trust me."; "Your mission is not complete. You cannot stay. Please do not rush back."
